// Fikstura testów smart_unfold: przypadki, na których ucinała stara heurystyka nawiasów.
export interface Repo {
  id: number;
}

/** Wieloliniowy parametr z typem obiektowym i typ zwracany w klamrach. */
export function promptContext(
  repo: Repo,
  args: {
    project: string;
    limit?: number;
  },
): { text: string; ids: number[] } {
  const ids: number[] = [repo.id];
  if (args.limit) ids.push(args.limit);
  return { text: args.project, ids };
}

export function ftsSearch(repo: Repo, q: string, opts: { limit?: number } = {}): string[] {
  const out: string[] = [q];
  if (opts.limit) out.length = Math.min(out.length, opts.limit);
  return out.concat(String(repo.id));
}

export async function load(): Promise<{ a: number }> {
  const a = 1;
  return { a };
}

export const handler = async (req: { body: string }): Promise<{ status: number }> => {
  const body = req.body.trim();
  return { status: body ? 200 : 400 };
};

export const double = (n: number) =>
  n * 2;

export function css(color: string): string {
  return `
.a {
  color: ${color};
}
}
`;
}

export function unquote(s: string): string {
  if (/^['"]/.test(s)) {
    return s.slice(1, -1);
  }
  return s;
}

export function lastOne(): string {
  return "koniec";
}

export class A {
  render(): string {
    return "A";
  }
}

export class B {
  private x = 1;
  render(): string {
    return `B${this.x}`;
  }
}
